jobs.name: Unibet (public sports API v2)
jobs.validationReason: Endpoint retired. The adapter targets /api/kambi/offer/v1/betoffer/list.json, which now returns 404 while the site returns 200. Observed 2026-09-26 via scripts/discover-unibet.mjs: prices moved to wss://sportsbff-ams.kindredext.net/betting-mqtt-sports/, a realtime feed, not a pollable REST endpoint. The public REST siblings (odds-ladder, az-menu, configured-landing-page) answer without cookies but carry no events. Re-enabling needs an MQTT client and a live reconnect test, not a URL change.
